title_seed: 三個 provider 三種資料形狀
central_problem: Crossref、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar 與其他 research sources 如何進入共同資料模型？
reader_takeaway: provider adapter 吸收資料形狀差異，但不自動保證內容相關或可引用。

known_at_the_time.fact: ec20e43 的 research tree 包含 Crossref、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar、arXiv、Unpaywall、DOAJ provider modules/configuration。
同一 commit 也包含 parser workers 與 research normalizer/scoring building blocks。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: provider-specific metadata could be represented through normalized research records and diagnostics paths。

not_yet_available.fact: 此 commit 證明模組存在，不證明每個 provider 在 arbitrary live topic 上成功或提供 qualifying full text。

observed_failures.symptom: different provider metadata and health/fallback states needed normalization and diagnostics
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: provider APIs have different payloads and availability
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: adapter and parser boundaries were being added
observed_failures.later_resolution: later current worktree retained provider health/retry diagnostics and separate content qualification

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: Three scholarly provider adapters are named in the 6/26 research tree: Crossref, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar.
tests_and_metrics.result: adapter names verified; not a success rate

engineering_decisions.decision: 用 shared normalized source model 隔離 provider payload shape，保留 provider identity。

architecture_state.state: provider adapters → normalized sources → scoring/dedupe → downstream evidence

safe_numbers.meaning: Crossref, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar are the editorial focus; not a success rate

safe_public_facts.fact: 接 provider 的第一個工程問題是資料形狀與健康狀態不一致，不是把三個 API 的結果直接串接。

retrospective_notes.note: 後來的 live QA 顯示 provider response、metadata、payload 與 qualifying artifact 必須分開計數；這是後見審計結果。

source_refs.why_it_supports_this_fact: provider and parser tree in committed history

publication_risks: 不要把 adapter existence 寫成 provider reliability。
不要公開 provider credentials 或 raw payload。
